advanced-filter-description: Wolayttatto: Advanced Piltterissa allows kko write a string containing following operators: == != <= >= && || ( ) A space is used as a separator between the Operators. Ne can piltterissa for ubba Dumma Sohota baggaara typing their names and values. For Example: Sohuwaa1 == Value1. Note: If sohota woy values contains spaces, ne need kko encapsulate them into single quotes. For Example: 'Sohuwaa 1' == 'Value 1'. For single control characters (' \/) kko be skipped, ne can use \. For example: Sohuwaa1 == I\'m. Also ne can combine multiple conditions. For Example: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Normally ubba operators are interpreted ppe left kko right. Ne can laamma the order baggaara placing brackets. For Example: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Also ne can koyya text sohota using regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

globalSearch-instructions-description: Wolayttatto: Searches can include operators kko refine the koyya.  Operators are specified baggaara writing the operator sunttaa and value separated baggaara a colon.  For example, an operator specification iya `mazgabaa:Blocked` would limit the koyya kko kaardiyata that are contained gidon a mazgabaa named *Blocked*.  If the value contains spaces woy special characters it must be enclosed gidon quotation marks (e.g. `__operator_list__:"Kko Review"`).

globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: Wolayttatto: `__operator_status__:<status>` - where *<status>* is one iya the following:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: Wolayttatto: `__predicate_all__` - ubba naagettiis and unarchived kaardiyata
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: Wolayttatto: `__predicate_ended__` - kaardiyata with an end gallassaa

globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: Wolayttatto: `__operator_has__:<field>` - where *<field>* is one iya `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` woy `__predicate_member__`.  Placing a `-` gidon front iya *<field>* searches for the absence iya a value gidon that sohuwaa (e.g. `has:-wurssetta` searches for kaardiyata without a wurssetta gallassaa).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: Wolayttatto: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - where *<sort-name>* is one iya `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` woy `__predicate_modified__`.  For a descending maaran wotha, place a `-` gidon front iya the maaran wotha sunttaa.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: Wolayttatto: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - where *<n>* is a positive integer expressing the number iya kaardiyata kko be displayed per page.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Wolayttatto: Multiple operators may be specified.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Wolayttatto: Similar operators are *Woy*ed together.  Kaardiyata that match any iya the conditions will be returned.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` would return kaardiyata contained gidon any mazgabaa named *Blocked* woy *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Wolayttatto: Differing operators are *AND*ed together.  Only kaardiyata that match ubba iya the differing operators are returned.  `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` returns only kaardiyata gidon the mazgabaa *Available* with a *red* malaataa.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Wolayttatto: Days can be specified as a positive woy negative integer woy using `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` woy `__predicate_year__` for the current period.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Wolayttatto: Text searches are case insensitive.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Wolayttatto: Baggaara default naagettiis kaardiyata are not searched.

database-migration-description: Wolayttatto: Migrate text-based data (everything except gattidobata and avatars, which stay bolla the filesystem) between MongoDB and FerretDB v1 (SQLite). The other database must be running and reachable (default ports: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; override with WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). After it finishes, point MONGO_URL at the other database and restart WeKan (bolla Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb woy =mongodb).

sandstorm-migration-description: Wolayttatto: When WeKan runs inside a Sandstorm grain, its old MongoDB 3 database is migrated kko FerretDB v1 (SQLite) bolla first launch, and gattidobata and avatars are laamettiis ppe the database kko the grain's faayileta/gattidobata and faayileta/avatars directories. This shows whether that migration succeeded and how much disk space the old raw MongoDB database faayileta still use inside the grain, and lets ne xayssa those raw faayileta kko free space.

cards-loading-description: Wolayttatto: WeKan loads bookkiya kaardiyata automatically: a big bookkiya (over the size threshold) loads only the kaardiyata currently visible (infinite scroll) plus a live count, so it stays fast and uses less memory and bandwidth, while smaller bookkiyata load every kaardiya for the simplest, fully featured experience. There is nothing kko configure. Operators can still force a mode with the Kaardiyata_Caanees (ubba/lazy/auto) and Kaardiyata_Caanees_LAZY_THRESHOLD environment variables.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Wolayttatto: Lazy kaardiya caanees is experimental: kaardiya counters and WIP limits are accurate, but the Calendar/Table/Gantt views and multi-doora reflect only the kaardiyata loaded so far. Reload open bookkiyata after changing this.

render-links-as-plain-text-description: Wolayttatto: When denttettiis, ubba links (both markdown links like [malaataa](url) and raw HTML <a href> tags) are always shown as plain, non-clickable text gidon every rich text sohuwaa (bookkiya and kaardiya titles, descriptions, qofata, checklists, etc.). This prevents misleading clickable links. Default is off, so links stay clickable.
always-show-code-as-text: Wolayttatto: Always show ubba code as plain text
always-show-code-as-text-description: Wolayttatto: When denttettiis, rich text is never rendered as markdown woy HTML: the entire source is always shown as plain text gidon every rich text sohuwaa (bookkiya and kaardiya titles, descriptions, qofata, checklists, etc.). This reveals hidden content — HTML qofata (<!-- -->), the target iya markdown links, JavaScript and any other code — so ubba code is always visible, not clickable, and not running. Default is off, so markdown is rendered normally.
disable-all-import-description: Wolayttatto: When denttettiis, ubba gelissa features are turned off: gelissees a bookkiya ppe WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo, as well as cloning a bookkiya. The gelissa menu options are hidden and the server rejects any gelissa request. Default is off.
disable-all-export-description: Wolayttatto: When denttettiis, ubba kessa features are turned off: exporting a bookkiya as WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, woy kko NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, and single-gattidobaa kessa. The kessa menu options are hidden and the server rejects any kessa request. Default is off.
disable-import-avatars-description: Wolayttatto: When denttettiis, avatars (oosanchchaa ne taarikiyaa pictures) are never gelissiis. This covers WeKan JSON gelissa, Trello gelissa, and avatar sync ppe external identity providers bolla login (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Names and other data are still gelissiis; only avatars are skipped. Default is off.
disable-export-avatars-description: Wolayttatto: When denttettiis, avatars (oosanchchaa ne taarikiyaa pictures) are never included when exporting a bookkiya (WeKan JSON and CSV kessa). Usernames and other data are still exported; only avatars are omitted. Default is off.
anonymize-import-users-description: Wolayttatto: When denttettiis, gelissees a WeKan JSON bookkiya replaces every gelissiis user's oosanchchaa sunttaa, full sunttaa and initials with counter placeholders (oosanchchaa1, oosanchchaa2, ...), drops their avatar, and rewrites @oosanchchaa sunttaa mentions (and the requested-baggaara / assigned-baggaara sohota) inside gelissiis kaardiya and qofaa content. Akkay real oosanchchaa identity ppe the source bookkiya is stored. The word "oosanchchaa" follows the qaalaa iya the person gelissees. Default is off.
anonymize-export-users-description: Wolayttatto: When denttettiis, exporting a bookkiya replaces every exported user's oosanchchaa sunttaa, full sunttaa and initials with counter placeholders (oosanchchaa1, oosanchchaa2, ...), drops their avatar, and rewrites @oosanchchaa sunttaa mentions (and the requested-baggaara / assigned-baggaara sohota) inside kaardiya and qofaa content. The exported faayiliyaa carries akkay real oosanchchaa identity. The word "oosanchchaa" follows the qaalaa iya the person exporting. Default is off.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Wolayttatto: When denttettiis, exporting a bookkiya replaces every exported user's oosanchchaa sunttaa, full sunttaa and initials with counter placeholders (oosanchchaa1, oosanchchaa2, ...), drops their avatar, and rewrites @oosanchchaa sunttaa mentions (and the requested-baggaara / assigned-baggaara sohota) inside kaardiya and qofaa content. The exported faayiliyaa carries akkay real oosanchchaa identity. The word "oosanchchaa" follows the qaalaa iya the person exporting. Default is off.
disable-activities-description: Wolayttatto: When denttettiis, oosuwaa-feed entries are never recorded and never shown anywhere (bookkiya sidebar and kaardiya oosuwaa tab). Akkay history iya who did what is kept. Default is off.
disable-notifications-description: Wolayttatto: When denttettiis, WeKan never sends xeella erissuwata (gidon-app, iimeeliyaa woy other services) for any oosuwaa. Activities can still be recorded (unless also digettiis above); only the erissuwata are suppressed. Default is off.
disable-watch-description: Wolayttatto: When denttettiis, the xeella feature is turned off — oosanchchata cannot subscribe kko bookkiyata, mazgabata woy kaardiyata kko receive erissuwata, and any attempt kko laamma a xeella level is rejected. Default is off.
backup-description: Wolayttatto: Guyye up Gattidobata, Avatars and/woy Data (ubba text-based collections that are not gattidobata woy avatars).
